video_prompt: A vertical 9:16 promotional video showcasing the Rent Receipt Generator on ToolsRift. The video uses a before-after editorial format with an oversized headline up top and screen recordings in the lower third. At 0s, the hook displays a frustrated person gathering paperwork. At 5s, a screen recording shows typing tenant details, selecting frequency, and entering landlord PAN. At 16s, clean text highlights key benefits like automatic revenue stamp notes and full year stacking. At 23s, the call to action reveals the tool name and website. The tone is clean, precise, and practical.

vo.text: Struggling to put together rent receipts for your HRA.
Enter tenant, landlord, and property details along with rent per month.
High annual rent requires a landlord PAN and revenue stamp note automatically.
Print a full year at once.
Find the Rent Receipt Generator on ToolsRift to get your stack ready.
